title: Expected recursive tree pair cost
statement: For every $d\in\mathbb N$ and every pairwise distinct $i,j,k\in\{0,1,2\}$, let $c(x)$ be the expected number of queries made by the randomized decision tree for recursive three-ary majority on input $x$, and let $M(x)$ be its value. For three independent uniformly distributed sign vectors $X_0,X_1,X_2\in\{−1,1\}^{3^d}$, the expected value of $c(X_i)+c(X_j)+\mathbf{1}_{\{M(X_i)\ne M(X_j)\}}c(X_k)$ equals $\frac52$ times the expected value of $c(X)$ for one uniformly distributed sign vector $X\in\{−1,1\}^{3^d}$.
hypotheses_covered: Three independent uniform sign vectors on the cube
